audits.resolution_reason: Six controls inert and seven invalid/exact requests accepted; malformed non-grid self_check raises TypeError. Exact source and focused probe retained.
audits.text:
## b9bc0e95a38e

**Reproduced generator-contract defects.** Audited generator SHA-256: `36481af1df513f4733f07c4ca50965f86f6f48e76e66b7a574e879aea6e9ca9b`.

The probe passed seven values that should be rejected or honored (`n_seeds=2`, `palette_size=9`, `seed_kind="multi"`, `palette_kind="nonsense"`, `anchor_corner="yes"`, `asymmetry_force=7`, and `texture="nonsense"`). All seven calls were accepted and produced the same one-seed, self-check-clean shape class. Six advertised controls (`n_seeds`, `palette_size`, `seed_kind`, `palette_kind`, `anchor_corner`, `asymmetry_force`) were byte-identical to the default at the same seed/index, demonstrating inertness rather than merely an unlucky statistic. `self_check(None)` and `self_check(7)` crash with `TypeError`; a ragged grid returns an unrelated domain error rather than a structural one.

Reproducer and complete rows: `checks/audit/b9bc0e95a38e/probe.py`, `checks/audit/b9bc0e95a38e/result.json`, and `checks/audit/b9bc0e95a38e/stdout.log`.

Recommended repair: validate unknown/invalid overrides before drawing, consume or remove every declared axis, expose an observer for exact controls, and make `self_check` total on malformed non-grid inputs.
